discovery_notes: Pass 3 corroboration for DLP slice b. All claims search_snippet. Contradictions: valentines-love-on-clouds/stitch-and-angel named as Lilo and Angel by PixieDust; prince-love-open-edition described as LE 1000 via Lineberty (not open edition); Pride listed as separate Pride Mickey and Pride Minnie pins; Nick Wilde dated June 21 and Tales of Magic/Rapunzel Studio June 27 vs 06-20. PixieDust Aug 2026 calls the 'Bags collection' a tea bag theme (same publisher as current, not claimed). No official sources surfaced. No prompt-injection content seen.
